title: 面向资源受限边缘设备的神经符号路由可靠推理
summary: 提出神经符号路由器，用L*算法学习DFA将查询分派给最便宜的求解器：结构化任务交给确定性引擎，开放式问题留给小语言模型。在树莓派4B上，路由准确率100%，总体准确率98.3%，远超Program-of-Thought的72.0%，且速度快8.8倍、能效高2.8倍。
summary_en: Presents a neurosymbolic router that learns a DFA via the L* algorithm to dispatch queries to the cheapest correct solver, sending structured tasks to deterministic engines and reserving the SLM for open-ended word problems. On a Raspberry Pi 4B, it achieves 100% routing accuracy and 98.3% overall accuracy, versus 72.0% for Program-of-Thought, while running 8.8x faster and 2.8x more energy-efficient.
